notes: Stories created for Local Disk Resilience with clear separation of contract, logic, integration, and testing.

stories.title: Define Local File Operation Resilience Contract
stories.description: Define a standardized schema and contract for local disk operations including retry policy, fallback behavior, error classification, and recovery metadata to ensure consistent handling across services.
stories.evidence: GAP: No standardized contract for local disk resilience; required for consistent retry/fallback handling

stories.title: Implement Retry and Fallback Logic for Local File Operations
stories.description: Build core logic to handle transient disk failures with configurable retries, exponential backoff, and fallback strategies (e.g., alternate temp storage or safe abort with recovery state).
stories.evidence: GAP: Retry and fallback logic not present in current local file handling

stories.title: Integrate Resilience Layer into Existing File Write/Read Paths
stories.description: Integrate the resilience logic into existing components that perform local disk operations (e.g., debug logging, pipeline temp files) to ensure all file interactions use the standardized resilience layer.

stories.title: Expose Resilience Status and Errors via Internal Logging Interface
stories.description: Provide structured logging and internal visibility into retry attempts, failures, and recovery actions for local disk operations to support debugging and observability.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Local Disk Resilience
stories.description: Create tests simulating disk failures (e.g., permission errors, unavailable paths, partial writes) to validate retry behavior, fallback execution, and data integrity after recovery.
stories.evidence: GAP: No existing tests covering local disk failure and recovery scenarios

per_feature.mitigation: Limit retries and enforce safe failure paths to prevent cascading errors
